findings.finding: M6 was treated as the active final acceptance milestone while M5 remained incomplete. Any accepted M5 change to Decision or Kernel would invalidate the behavior and report hashes used by M6.
INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_AGENT_UNAVAILABLE is not a current architecture blocker and must not control milestone ordering. Independent review resumes only after M5 freezes the final source hashes.
Existing M6 output remains useful as pre-acceptance diagnostic evidence that found Report defects, but it is not final acceptance evidence under v27.

executionRules: Do not run additional blind or deep review before M5 completes.
First close the current M3 and M4 production changes, current-hash gates and event history into a reproducible baseline.
Do not repeat the existing profiles or rejected route-cache experiments without a new architecture hypothesis.
Only reopen implementation for a macro optimization whose measured upper bound covers the meaningful remaining gap.
After M5 freezes source hashes, regenerate only the M6 evidence invalidated by Kernel, Decision, Report or UI changes.
Do not reopen M2 or M3 unless the M5 equivalence gates expose a semantic or contract defect.
nextExitCondition: Current M3 and M4 production changes and their current-hash evidence are classified and committed without M5 logs or provisional M6 artifacts; then M5 returns to the blocked architecture decision.
